cards.target: Sen hastanede anlamadın.
cards.english: You didn't understand at the hospital.

cards.target: Kendine güvenmelisin, yapabilirsin.
cards.english: You should believe in yourself, you can do it.
cards.existing: `-malı/-meli` = 'must / should': `gitmeliyim` (I must go), `çalışmalısın` (you must work). Strong obligation; for softer 'should' use `gerekiyor` patterns.

cards.target: Zaman zaman eski arkadaşlarımla buluşurum.
cards.english: From time to time I meet with old friends.

cards.target: Dedem her akşam radyo dinlerdi.
cards.english: My grandfather used to listen to the radio every evening.

cards.target: Günaydın komşu, bahçeniz çok güzel olmuş!
cards.english: Good morning neighbor, your garden looks beautiful!

cards.target: Kusura bakmayın, sizi rahatsız etmek istememiştim.
cards.english: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to bother you.
cards.existing: `-miş` (with harmony) marks inferred or reported past: `gelmiş` = 'apparently came / I heard he came / it seems he came'. English needs auxiliaries; Turkish bakes it into one suffix.

cards.target: Küçük kardeşim hep benden öğrenmek ister.
cards.english: My little sibling always wants to learn from me.

cards.target: Dün gece fırtına çıktı, ağaçlar devrildi.
cards.english: A storm broke out last night, trees fell down.

cards.target: Bu güzel havada evde oturmak istemiyorum.
cards.english: I don't want to sit at home in this nice weather.

cards.target: Eskiden bu sokakta at arabaları gezerdi.
cards.english: In the old days horse carriages used to pass through this street.

cards.target: Yeni telefon aldım ama alışamadım henüz.
cards.english: I bought a new phone but I haven't gotten used to it yet.

cards.target: Büyük şehirde yaşamak bazen çok stresli oluyor.
cards.english: Living in a big city is sometimes very stressful.

cards.target: Evde iki kedi ve bir köpek besliyoruz.
cards.english: We keep two cats and one dog at home.

cards.target: Soğuk havada sıcak çorba içmek çok güzel.
cards.english: Drinking hot soup in cold weather is very nice.

cards.target: Bu hafta sonu dışarı çıkmayacağız, evde dinleneceğiz.
cards.english: We won't go out this weekend, we'll rest at home.

cards.target: Öğretmen öğleden sonra şarkı söyledi çünkü sıkılmıştı.
cards.english: The teacher sang in the afternoon because she was bored.
cards.existing: Distinguish: `-di` = I saw it happen. `-miş` = I'm reporting it from elsewhere, or I'm noticing it now (resultative). `Yağmur yağmış` = 'it has rained' (I'm seeing the wet ground).

cards.target: Market evin karşısında, beş dakika yürüyüş mesafesinde.
cards.english: The market is across from the house, five minutes walking distance.

cards.target: Yaşlı adam her sabah parkta yürüyüş yapar.
cards.english: The old man takes a walk in the park every morning.

cards.target: Her sabah erken kalkarım ve yürüyüşe çıkarım.
cards.english: I get up early every morning and go for a walk.
cards.existing: After vowels, insert 'y': `gelirken` (while coming – gelir + ken). After consonants, just stick `-ken` on.

cards.target: Sabahın erken saatlerinde şehir çok sessiz oluyor.
cards.english: The city is very quiet in the early hours of the morning.

cards.target: Kaza çok büyükmüş, yol saatlerce kapalı kalmış.
cards.english: The accident was apparently very serious, and the road remained closed for hours.

cards.target: Umarım trafik sıkışık olmaz, toplantıya yetişmem lazım.
cards.english: I hope traffic isn't heavy, I need to make it to the meeting.

cards.target: Yarın erken kalkmam gerekiyor, alarm kurmam lazım.
cards.english: I need to get up early tomorrow, I need to set an alarm.

cards.target: Bej halı kanepenin altında sehpanın önünde seriliydi.
cards.english: The beige carpet was laid out under the couch, in front of the coffee table.

cards.target: Yol kenarında mısır satan amca her yaz orada.
cards.english: The uncle selling corn by the road is there every summer.

cards.target: Akşam geç saatlerde markete gittim, pek bir şey kalmamıştı.
cards.english: I went to the market late in the evening, not much was left.
cards.existing: Used for fairy tales, rumours, news reports, and surprise: `meğer haklıymışsın` = 'turns out you were right' (with discovery tone). Adds narrative distance.

cards.target: Babamın arabası tamirde.
cards.english: My father's car is being repaired.

cards.target: Arkadaşımın düğünü yazın olacak.
cards.english: My friend's wedding will be in summer.

cards.target: Yeni komşularla kendini tanıştırdı.
cards.english: He introduced himself to the new neighbours.

cards.target: Garson otelde mutlulukla çalıştı.
cards.english: The waiter worked happily at the hotel.

cards.target: Annem dikkatle bir elbise dikti.
cards.english: My mother carefully sewed a dress.

cards.target: Müzisyen markette neşeyle çalışmaya başladı.
cards.english: The musician cheerfully started working at the market.

cards.target: Biz birazdan otelde yapacağız.
cards.english: We will do it at the hotel in a moment.

cards.target: Postacı her sabah mektupları dağıtıyor.
cards.english: The postman delivers letters every morning.

cards.target: Okulda üç yüz öğrenci var.
cards.english: The school has three hundred students.

cards.target: Evde kimse yok, herkes dışarıda.
cards.english: Nobody is at home, everyone is outside.

cards.target: Arkadaşım Ankara'da bir hastanede çalışıyor.
cards.english: My friend works at a hospital in Ankara.

cards.target: Aile büyüklerimize saygı göstermek önemli.
cards.english: It's important to show respect to our family elders.

cards.target: Sessizce odaya girdim, bebek uyuyordu.
cards.english: I quietly entered the room, the baby was sleeping.

cards.target: Bu soru kolay değil, dikkatli düşünmeliyiz.
cards.english: This question is not easy, we must think carefully.

cards.target: Marketin kasasında uzun bir kuyruk vardı.
cards.english: There was a long queue at the market checkout.

cards.target: Balık lokantasında iki kişilik masa ayırttım.
cards.english: I reserved a table for two at the fish restaurant.

cards.target: Dansçı performans öncesinde saatlerce ısınarak hazırlandı.
cards.english: The dancer prepared by warming up for hours before the performance.

cards.target: Bu mağazada büyük indirimler var, kaçırmayalım.
cards.english: There are big discounts at this store, let's not miss them.

cards.target: Terzi yaz tatilinde sahilde bisiklet sürüyordu.
cards.english: The tailor was riding a bike at the beach during summer vacation.

cards.target: Babam otuz yıllık hizmetten sonra emekli oldu.
cards.english: My father retired after thirty years of service.

cards.target: Annemin yaptığı mercimek çorbası dünyanın en güzeli.
cards.english: My mother's lentil soup is the best in the world.

cards.target: Masada üç tabak ve beş bardak var.
cards.english: There are three plates and five glasses on the table.

cards.target: Ali öğleden sonra bahçede eldivenlerini topladı.
cards.english: Ali gathered his gloves in the garden in the afternoon.

cards.target: Komşular gün batımında bahçede sohbet etti.
cards.english: The neighbors chatted in the garden at sunset.

cards.target: Arkeolog bu sabah kasapta et aldı.
cards.english: The archaeologist bought meat at the butcher shop this morning.

cards.target: Bu şehirde birçok müze ve tarihi cami var.
cards.english: There are many museums and historical mosques in this city.

cards.target: Arkeolog bu sabah koyda eski bir kalıntı buldu.
cards.english: The archaeologist found an old ruin in the bay this morning.

cards.target: Kardeşim hafta içi otelde çalıştı.
cards.english: My sibling worked at the hotel on weekdays.

cards.target: Fatma hafta içi otelde bir kitap okudu.
cards.english: Fatma read a book at the hotel on weekdays.

cards.target: Çiftçi bu sabah deniz kıyısında çiçek topladı.
cards.english: The farmer picked flowers on the coast this morning.

cards.target: Müzisyen konser öncesinde sessiz odada yoğunlaşarak meditasyon yaptı.
cards.english: The musician meditated by concentrating in a quiet room before the concert.

cards.target: Mühendis stadyumda maçı üzüntüyle izledi.
cards.english: The engineer watched the match sadly at the stadium.

cards.target: Garson plajda kaybettiği anahtarı sabırla buldu.
cards.english: The waiter patiently found the key he had lost at the beach.

cards.target: Dedem postaneden öfkeyle çıktı.
cards.english: My grandfather left the post office angrily.

cards.target: Çiftçi tiyatroda sessizce oturdu.
cards.english: The farmer sat quietly at the theater.

cards.target: Terzi restorandan gönüllü olarak temizledi.
cards.english: The tailor cleaned the restaurant voluntarily.

cards.target: Bu kitapevinde her çeşit kitap bulabilirsiniz.
cards.english: You can find all kinds of books in this bookstore.

cards.target: Anneannem hafta içi plajda türkü söyledi.
cards.english: My grandmother sang a folk song at the beach on weekdays.
